camera_follow.summary: Camera that follows the host: a smoothed Camera2D, or a third-person orbit camera (mouse or look_left/look_right keys).

key_orbit_speed.doc: 3D orbit speed in radians/s for look_left / look_right

limit_to_level.doc: 2D: keep the camera inside the level bounds when the level defines them

chase_ai.summary: Chase the nearest body of a group when it is within sight, otherwise stand still.

speed.doc: Speed (0 = automatic: 90 px/s in 2D, 3.5 m/s in 3D)

stop_distance.doc: Stop this close to the target (0 = automatic: 6 px / 1 m)

gravity.doc: 2D gravity in px/s^2 (top-down enemies keep 0; platformer chasers use ~1300). 3D always 20 m/s^2

contact_damage.summary: Hurts bodies of the target group while they overlap the host (spikes, enemies). Optional stomp for platformers.

target_group.doc: Group of bodies that get hurt

radius.doc: Hit radius (0 = automatic: 16 px in 2D, 0.9 m in 3D)

interval.doc: Seconds between hits on the same overlap

stomp.doc: 2D only: landing on top hurts the host instead and bounces the player

knockback.doc: Push the victim away at this speed

dialogue.summary: Talk to an NPC: lines appear in the HUD when the player walks up (enter) or presses interact.

trigger.doc: Walk up, or press the interact key nearby

radius.doc: Talk radius (0 = automatic: 48 px in 2D, 2.5 m in 3D)

line_time.doc: Seconds each line stays when trigger=enter

loop.doc: Start over after the last line

door_trigger.summary: Trigger zone: finish the level (goal), go to another level, or show a message. Can require a flag such as a key.

requires_flag.doc: Flag the player must hold (a collected key)

message.doc: Text shown for kind=message (or when the door is locked)

radius.doc: Trigger radius (0 = automatic: 20 px in 2D, 1.2 m in 3D)

first_person_controller.summary: First-person movement for a CharacterBody3D: WASD, jump, mouse look (or look_left/right keys), creates its own Camera3D at eye height.

eye_height.doc: Camera height above the host origin

key_look_speed.doc: Radians per second for look_left / look_right

kill_y.doc: Falling below this y counts as death

health.summary: Hit points with brief invulnerability. The player dying loses the game; other entities score and disappear.

invulnerable_time.doc: Seconds of immunity after being hurt

score_value.doc: Score awarded when this entity dies

remove_on_death.doc: Free the host when it dies (the player is never freed)

death_sfx.doc: Sound effect name to play on death

patrol_ai.summary: Walk back and forth around the start position; turns at walls and (in platformers) at ledges.

axis.doc: Patrol axis (use y for vertical top-down patrols, z for 3D depth)

speed.doc: Speed (0 = automatic: 60 px/s in 2D, 2.5 m/s in 3D)

distance.doc: How far to each side of the start (0 = automatic: 96 px / 4 m)

gravity.doc: 2D gravity in px/s^2 (set 0 for top-down enemies); 3D uses 20 m/s^2

turn_at_ledges.doc: 2D platformers: turn instead of walking off a ledge

ledge_probe.doc: Distance ahead of the body checked for ground

pickup.summary: Collectable: coins/score, healing, keys (flags). Removes the host when the target touches it.

value.doc: Score or hit points to award

radius.doc: Pickup radius (0 = automatic: 14 px in 2D, 0.8 m in 3D)

counts_for_win.doc: Counts toward the collect_all win rule

platformer_controller.summary: Side-scrolling movement for a CharacterBody2D: run, jump with coyote time, double jump, gravity, fall-death.

jump_speed.doc: Initial upward speed of a jump

coyote_time.doc: Seconds after leaving a ledge you can still jump

kill_y.doc: Falling below this y counts as death (the level may override it)

projectile.summary: Created by the shooter component; flies straight, damages the target group, disappears on walls.

shooter.summary: Fires projectiles. mode=player shoots on the shoot action (aim from movement, mouse or camera); mode=turret shoots automatically at the nearest body of aim_group.

target_group.doc: Group the projectile damages (player shots: enemy, enemy shots: player)

aim_group.doc: turret mode: whom to aim at

max_range.doc: turret mode: shoot only within this range (0 = automatic: 360 px / 18 m)

muzzle_offset.doc: Spawn this far in front of the host (0 = automatic: 18 px / 1 m)

spawner.summary: Spawns copies of an entity scene around the host at an interval, up to a maximum alive.

scene.doc: res:// path of the entity scene (entities/<name>.tscn)

max_alive.doc: Never exceed this many living spawns

spread.doc: Random offset radius (0 = automatic: 120 px in 2D, 5 m in 3D)

active_group.doc: Only spawn while a body of this group exists (empty = always)

spin_bob.summary: Decoration: spin around the up axis and/or float up and down (nice for coins and gems).

spin_degrees.doc: Degrees per second around the vertical axis (3D) or in the plane (2D)

bob_height.doc: Bob amplitude (0 = none; ~4 px in 2D, ~0.15 m in 3D)

sprite_anim.summary: Frame animation for a sprite sheet (Sprite export): picks idle / run / jump rows from the host's motion.

sprite_path.doc: Child Sprite2D of the host to animate

face_motion.doc: Flip the sprite to the direction of travel

third_person_controller.summary: Camera-relative third-person movement for a CharacterBody3D with jump and gravity; pairs with camera_follow (orbit mode).

turn_speed.doc: How fast the body turns to face movement

kill_y.doc: Falling below this y counts as death

topdown_controller.summary: Eight-way top-down movement for a CharacterBody2D; the facing vector follows movement (or the mouse when aim_with_mouse is set).

aim_with_mouse.doc: Face the mouse cursor instead of the move direction

rotate_host.doc: Rotate the host to face the aim direction
